description: Header file defining ARM NEON intrinsic functions for non-temporal memory operations, specific to ARM64 architecture, used for optimized CRC computations.

methods.name: _mm_sfence
methods.description: Memory fence ensuring store visibility before subsequent stores.

methods.name: _mm_loadu_si128
methods.description: Loads 128-bit data from unaligned memory address.

methods.name: _mm_stream_si128
methods.description: Stores 128-bit data to memory without polluting caches.

methods.name: _mm_set_epi8
methods.description: Sets 16 signed 8-bit integer values into a 128-bit register.
